comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The official name is "The Great Pyramid of Giza's Past". It is discovery the middle / center section of legacy from The Great Pyramid of Giza's Past legacy theme. You will get the "Capstone Pendant" upon visiting. You also get 500 Sophia from discover this.

Here, you can search by digging the yellow pillar spot, hoping you might be able to snatch the good items. Then there is an exit once you done.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A word of caution concerning the Legacy zones: if you disconnect or log out in them, you will log back in to find yourself in the normal landing zone with the following message: "The power from the Book of Wisdom faded and you returned back to the original place."

This will happen only if you enter the Legacy zone and make the discovery. This is only a bother to those who plan to farm the 10 light pillars, of course... or who were hoping they could stay there for a while. *cough* Cheers.
